$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.query.graph. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-GRAPH-ID-UNDERSCORE-BARE
arms.note: a `_` is written bare, so it reads as the escape a `.` or another character opens and two names share one id (`a_d` and `a.`)

arms.name: M-GRAPH-LAMBDA-UNFOLDED
arms.note: a lambda or local function stays a node of its own instead of folding into the member that declares it

arms.name: M-GRAPH-DEPTH-SPENT-ON-LOCALS
arms.note: a member is expanded through its own body only, so what its lambdas and local functions call is a hop further, and one hop from it draws nothing

arms.name: M-GRAPH-CALLER-HOP-ON-LOCALS
arms.find: final other: String = builder.memberRoot(outward ? e.to : e.from);
arms.replace: final other: String = outward ? e.to : e.from;
arms.note: the walk queues the lambda a call came from instead of its member, so the next hop inward spends itself on the edge from the member to its own lambda

arms.name: M-GRAPH-LOCAL-RECURSION-DRAWN
arms.note: a local function calling itself is drawn as its member calling itself

arms.name: M-GRAPH-EXTERNAL-ID-MERGED
arms.note: an external node takes the id of a node of the scope that bears its name, so a std `String` and a root-package `String` are one node

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-BACK-EDGE-HIDDEN
arms.note: a weight floor judges each direction alone, so the light way back of a heavy pair disappears and the cycle it closes is hidden

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-FOLDED-EDGE-AS-RECURSION
arms.note: an edge from a package into its own subpackage folds into a self-loop of the ancestor, a recursion nobody wrote

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-NAMED-ANY-LEVEL
arms.note: a focus at the type level names the package a lift brought in above the types, and the view silently centres on it

arms.name: M-GRAPH-DIFF-UNCHANGED-UNFOLDED
arms.note: every member stays a node of its own, so the comparison of a large scope is every member it declares instead of what changed

arms.name: M-GRAPH-DIFF-WEIGHT-IGNORED
arms.note: an edge both versions hold reads unchanged whatever its weight, so a call site added or removed beside another one goes unseen

arms.name: M-GRAPH-DIFF-UNCHANGED-EDGE-KEPT
arms.find: if (change == null && status[e.from] == null && status[e.to] == null) continue;
arms.note: every edge between unchanged types is drawn, burying the change in the whole graph of the scope

arms.name: M-GRAPH-DIFF-INVERSION-AS-CYCLE
arms.find: (e.change != Added && back.change != Added) || (e.change != Removed && back.change != Removed)
arms.note: a dependency removed one way and added the other reads as a cycle, though neither version holds both ways

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-OPENING-INSIDE-TWICE
arms.note: an edge between two nodes inside the node opened is counted from both its ends and drawn at twice its weight

arms.name: M-GRAPH-IMPORT-TYPE-UNNESTED
arms.note: a type of the import graph stands outside its package, so a page has no package to open and draws one flat view

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-HOLDER-UNCHANGED
arms.note: a type or a package holding an added, removed or changed member reads unchanged once folded, so a view above the members shows no change at all

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-FOLD-UNSUMMED
arms.note: an edge folded from a reweighted one counts its later weight as its earlier, so the folded edge's earlier weight is wrong

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-EDGE-CHANGE-DROPPED
arms.note: a view draws every edge of a comparison uncoloured: what was added, removed or reweighted is lost at the first fold or filter

arms.name: M-GRAPH-VIEW-SHUT-EDGE-UNMARKED
arms.note: a changed edge between two unchanged nodes folding into one is dropped unmarked, so the package or type holding the change reads unchanged
